hk.description:
Wipr blocks ads, popups, trackers, cookie warnings, and other nasty things that make the web slow and ugly.

Websites in Safari will look clean, load fast, and stop invisibly tracking you. You’ll notice significant improvements to your battery life and data usage. Setup is a snap.

The Filtr add-on extends Wipr’s blocking to all apps on your devices. It acts at the network level, but unlike a VPN, it can access none of your data, and can be used in conjunction with VPNs, iCloud Private Relay, and custom DNS.

Wipr’s blocklist is updated twice a week automatically, and has enhanced versions for the following languages: Bosnian, Chinese, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Estonian, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Icelandic, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Macedonian, Malay, Montenegrin, Norwegian, Polish, Romanian, Russian, Serbian, Slovak, Spanish, Thai, and Vietnamese.

Wipr is a universal app: install it on all your devices (iPhone, iPad, Mac, Vision Pro) with a single purchase. It’s fully accessible with VoiceOver, Voice Control, and more. Dark, Tinted, and Clear icon variants are included. Family Sharing is supported.

Because it’s developed by a single independent developer and 100% funded by its users, Wipr only answers to you: no one can pay to have their ads unblocked, and there are no “acceptable ads”.

This app was made with love and patience. I hope you’ll enjoy using it as much as I enjoyed designing and building it.

– Kaylee

建立足夠強大的骰子組合，淨化阿斯特賴亞失控的腐敗並拯救星系。

特色
• 獨特的雙重「傷害」系統：腐化與淨化——《阿斯特賴亞》有一種新型的「傷害」系統。淨化可以用來傷害敵人或治療自己，而腐化可以用來傷害自己或治療敵人。使用淨化來安撫敵人，或腐化自己來釋放力量以扭轉戰局。
• 動態生命條系統——將技能附加到生命條後，可以使用腐化來啟用這些技能並釋放強大的能力。但是要小心，如果接受了太多腐敗，你可能會被會被它消耗殆盡。
• 不是紙牌，是骰子！——建立適合你遊戲風格的骰子組合。從超過350顆骰子和三種骰子類型中選擇：可靠安全、完美平衡或強大有風險。以高風險、高報酬為核心設計的骰子型系統。
• 自訂骰子——編輯骰子面，以新動作來創造自己的命運，讓強大結果的機率對自己有利。
• 在六位勇敢神諭者中選擇——每一位都擁有自己獨特的骰子組合、能力與玩法風格。從靈巧的施法者到野蠻的狂戰士，無論是喜歡讓對手挨轟求饒，還是想以智取勝，總有一位適合你。
• 發現超過170種修改賜福——為神諭者注入獨特的被動技，產生強大的效果，將改變你的基本策略。在恆星賜福（力量較弱的被動效果）或黑洞賜福（具有不利條件的強大被動效果）之間進行選擇。

真正的工廠 - 充滿樂趣
您是大老闆，現在是時候負責您自己的桌面工廠了。組織工廠車間，管理您的工人，購買機械並設計高效的生產線 - 所有這些都在規定期限內完成，並讓您的客戶滿意！ 

開放式沙盒體驗
放輕鬆，這是一個沙盒體驗游戲，您可以在其中思考、衡量和鑽研事物，直到它們按照您想要的方式工作。當您生產超過50種獨特的產品類型（由多個零件和零件製成）時，向客戶和不斷變化的市場供應產品 - 所有這些都可以用不同的材料和生產方法來製造。沒有兩個工廠看起來相同。

小小手，大夢想
從一個小作坊開始，然後擴展到佈滿桌子的工廠。解鎖更先進的機器，增加更多的生產方法，還有最重要的，增加空間。很快，您將運行多條生產線，每天生產成百上千的先進產品，並欣喜地觀看可愛的工人完成實際工作。

特點：
- 各種各樣的行業和廣泛的產品
- 側重於實際問題，而不是價值、經濟或物流
- 在藍圖上組織生產的所有步驟
- 隨著您解鎖更多的辦公桌空間，工廠將發展
- 全面模擬的日/夜週期
- 照顧好您的工人！如果使他們太辛苦地工作，他們會像蒼蠅一樣墜落

在終極駕駛遊樂場中燃燒橡膠並撕碎金屬！

Wreckfest 充滿了升級和自定義選項。無論您是準備使用加固保險槓、防滾架、側面保護裝置等進行下一次拆遷德比，還是使用空氣濾清器、凸輪軸、燃油系統等發動機性能部件為您的汽車進行一場激烈的比賽，Wreckfest 正在成為最好的競技賽車遊戲。

tr.description:
Astrea is a DICE-deck-building roguelike that flips the script on deckbuilders by using dice instead of cards and an unique dual “damage” system: Purification vs Corruption.

Features

• Unique dual “damage” system: Purification vs Corruption - In Astrea there is a new type of “damage” system. Purification can be used to damage enemies or heal yourself. On the other hand, corruption can be used to damage yourself or heal the enemies. Pacify enemies through Purification, or Corrupt yourself to unleash abilities that help tip the scales.
• Dynamic Health Bar system - With skills attached to your health bar, you can take Corruption to enable these skills and unleash powerful abilities. But be careful, if you take too much Corruption you will be consumed by it.
• Not cards, but dice! - Build a dice pool that fits your playstyle. Choose from over 350 dice and three dice types; reliably safe, perfectly balanced, or powerfully risky. A dice type system designed with high-risk, high-reward in its core.
• Customize your dice - Forge your fate by editing die faces with new actions, tipping the odds of powerful results into your favor.
• Choose from Six Brave Oracles - Each possessing their own unique dice sets, abilities, and playstyles. From ingenious spellcasters to brutish berserkers, whether you like beating the opponent into submission or outsmarting them with clever plays, there’s an oracle for you.
• Uncover over 170 modifying Blessings - Imbue your Oracle with unique passives yielding potent effects that changes up your fundamental tactics. Choose between Star Blessings, passive effects with lower power, or Black Hole Blessings, powerful passive effects with a drawback.

Imagine a magical factory, appearing right in your living room. A carefully planned masterpiece, where diligent workers throw together anything customers want. Rubber ducks and dressers, drones and electric guitars, scooters and other wonderful goods can be created from many different materials and sold for hard cash – cash you invest right back into your factory to get more machines, more workers and grow your business. In Little Big Workshop you become a factory tycoon!

Real factories - made FUN
You are the Big Boss and it’s time to take charge of your very own tabletop factory. Organize the factory floor, manage your workers, purchase machinery, and design efficient production lines - all within the time-limit and to your client's satisfaction! 

An open-ended sandbox-experience
Take it easy, it’s a sandbox-experience where you think, ponder and poke at things until you get it to work the way you’d like. Supply products to clients and an ever-changing market, as you produce over 50 unique product types, built from multiple parts and pieces - all of which can be created with different materials and production methods. No two factories should ever look the same.

Tiny hands, big dreams
Start out with just a small workshop and expand to a desk-filling factory. Unlock ever fancier machines, add even more production methods, and most of all, more room. Soon enough you’ll be running multiple production lines, producing hundreds of advanced products each day, and watching with joy as your cute workers do the actual work.

- Varying industries and a wide range of products
- Focus on practical problems, not on values, economics, or logistics
- Organize all steps of the production on a blueprint
- Factories grow as you unlock more desk space
- Fully simulated Day/Night-cycle

A turn-based deckbuilding roguelite — Dungeon Merge.
Every run, a different strategy. A different hero. A different ending.

■ A Cast of Unique Heroes — Not just stronger stats. A completely different game.
Assassin: Double damage to a single target. Pick one. Make it count.
Engineer: Stack shields, then unleash area devastation. Defense is offense.
Gambler: Free level-up rerolls. When luck becomes strategy.
Noble: +1 level-up choices, gold-powered leveling at shrines. Money is your weapon.
…Every hero plays like a different game.

■ Diverse Skill Cards — Not collection. Combination. Your deck is your strategy.
Chain Lightning: Hit up to 3 enemies in a chain
Double Cast: Trigger the same skill twice in a row
Replicate: Copy any card in your deck on the spot
Skill grades: Common → Rare → Epic → Legend. Upgrade mid-combat.

■ Diverse Relics — Sometimes a relic changes everything.
Chalice: Die once, revive at 50% HP
Shard of Collapse: For the next 3 battles, all non-boss enemies start with 1 HP
Shackles of Binding: +1 mana per turn, but shop prices rise 25%
Sanctuary Lantern: Fully restore HP every time you enter a shop

■ Distinct Enemies — Every battle is a new puzzle. Read the pattern or die.
Treasure Goblin: Escape in 7 turns if you don't kill it fast enough
Snowman: Freezes you for 1 turn
Crow: Forces you to discard a random card from your hand
Multiple bosses, each with unique phases and attack patterns

■ Seal System — The real game starts here.
Normal mode is just the beginning. The true challenge unlocks with the Seals.
Mix and match Trials and Contracts to design your own difficulty.
Only a handful of players will ever clear the hardest combination.

■ Endless Replayability
3 regions × 17 floors — procedurally generated every run
Battle, Event, Elite, Shrine, Shop — diverse room types
Different maps, enemy combos, and card drops every time

■ Features
Turn-based strategy + deckbuilding
Diverse heroes, skills, relics, and enemies
Seal System — design your own difficulty with Trials and Contracts
Procedurally generated dungeons
6 languages supported — Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese, German, French
Cloud save
Tear the dungeon apart with your own strategy.
One run is never enough.

pt.description:
Astrea é um jogo roguelike que dá uma nova cara para a construção de decks usando dados em vez de cartas com um sistema de "danos" duplo exclusivo: Purificação x Corrupção.

Recursos
• Sistema de ""danos"" duplo exclusivo: Purificação x Corrupção - Em Astrea, você descobre um novo tipo de sistema de ""danos"". A Purificação pode ser usada para causar danos nos inimigos ou curar a si mesmo. Já a Corrupção pode ser usada para causar danos a si mesmo ou curar os inimigos. Pacifique os inimigos usando a Purificação, ou use a Corrupção em si para liberar habilidades que podem ajudar a virar o jogo.
• Sistema de barra de vida dinâmico - Como há habilidades ligadas à sua barra de vida, você pode se Corromper para ativar e liberar essas habilidades poderosas. Só tome cuidado para não se Corromper demais e deixar a Corrupção consumir você.
• Não são cartas, são dados! - Construa uma Pool de Dados que combina com o seu estilo de jogo. Escolha entre 350 dados de três tipos: o confiável Seguro, o perfeitamente Equilibrado ou o poderoso Arriscado. Um sistema de tipos de dados composto de alto risco e imensas recompensas.
• Personalização de dados - Molde seu futuro trocando as faces dos dados por novas ações, e mude as probabilidades dos resultados a seu favor.
• Seis valentes Oráculos para escolher - Cada um tem conjuntos de dados, habilidades e estilos de jogo únicos. De conjuradores habilidosos a beserkers brutos dão a você a chance de superar seus adversários com jogadas inteligentes ou de subjugá-los sem piedade. Há sempre um Oráculo perfeito para você.
• Mais de 170 Bênçãos modificadoras para descobrir - Dê ao seu Oráculo habilidades passivas únicas repletas de efeitos que podem mudar suas táticas básicas. Escolha entre as Bênçãos das Estrelas, efeitos passivos com pouca força, ou Bênçãos do Buraco Negro, efeitos passivos potentes com uma desvantagem.

Imagine uma fábrica mágica bem na sua sala. Uma obra de arte cuidadosamente planejada, onde funcionários dedicados criam qualquer coisa que os clientes desejarem. Patos de borracha e cômodas, drones e guitarras elétricas, patinetes e outras coisas incríveis podem ser criadas a partir de diferentes materiais e vendidas em troca de dinheiro – o qual você pode reinvestir na fábrica para obter mais máquinas, mais funcionários e expandir o seu negócio. Na Little Big Workshop, você se torna um magnata da fabricação!

Fábricas de verdade - só que DIVERTIDAS
Você é o Chefe e é hora de assumir a sua própria fábrica. Organize o chão da fábrica, gerencie seus funcionários, compre maquinário e monte linhas de produção eficientes – tudo dentro do prazo e garantindo a satisfação do cliente! 

Uma experiência aberta sandbox
Vá com calma: essa é uma experiência sandbox em que você pensa, reflete e mexe nas coisas até conseguir deixar as coisas do jeito que quiser. Forneça produtos para clientes num mercado em constante mudança, produzindo mais de 50 tipos únicos de produtos feitos com inúmeras partes e peças – sendo que todos podem ser criados com diferentes materiais e métodos de produção. Não existem duas fábricas iguais.

Mãos pequenas, sonhos grandes
Comece com uma pequena oficina e a transforme numa fábrica cheia de oficinas. Desbloqueie máquinas cada vez mais sofisticadas, acrescente ainda mais métodos de produção e, o mais importante, crie mais espaço. Em breve você terá várias linhas de produção, produzindo centenas de produtos avançados todos os dias e observando com alegria os seus funcionários fofinhos realizarem o trabalho pesado.

Características:
- Indústrias variadas e uma ampla gama de produtos
- Foco em problemas práticos, não em valores, economia ou logística
- Organize todos os passos da produção no papel primeiro
- As fábricas crescem à medida que você desbloqueia mais espaço para mesas
- Ciclo diurno / noturno totalmente simulado
- Cuide dos seus funcionários! Se eles trabalharem demais, eles caem como moscas
- Linda arte em estilo de cidade modelo

Desvia-te de balas, recolhe power-ups massivos e usa sabiamente habilidades especiais para derrotares os teus inimigos. Duas campanhas com 50 níveis no total, ataques de vários inimigos mortais e muitas lutas épicas contra chefes. Estás preparado para a tarefa?

A turn-based deckbuilding roguelite — Dungeon Merge.
Every run, a different strategy. A different hero. A different ending.

Assassin: Double damage to a single target. Pick one. Make it count.
Engineer: Stack shields, then unleash area devastation. Defense is offense.
Gambler: Free level-up rerolls. When luck becomes strategy.
Noble: +1 level-up choices, gold-powered leveling at shrines. Money is your weapon.
…Every hero plays like a different game.

■ Diverse Skill Cards — Not collection. Combination. Your deck is your strategy.
Chain Lightning: Hit up to 3 enemies in a chain
Double Cast: Trigger the same skill twice in a row
Replicate: Copy any card in your deck on the spot
Skill grades: Common → Rare → Epic → Legend. Upgrade mid-combat.

■ Diverse Relics — Sometimes a relic changes everything.
Chalice: Die once, revive at 50% HP
Shard of Collapse: For the next 3 battles, all non-boss enemies start with 1 HP
Shackles of Binding: +1 mana per turn, but shop prices rise 25%
Sanctuary Lantern: Fully restore HP every time you enter a shop

■ Distinct Enemies — Every battle is a new puzzle. Read the pattern or die.
Treasure Goblin: Escape in 7 turns if you don't kill it fast enough
Snowman: Freezes you for 1 turn
Crow: Forces you to discard a random card from your hand
Multiple bosses, each with unique phases and attack patterns

Mix and match Trials and Contracts to design your own difficulty.
Only a handful of players will ever clear the hardest combination.

3 regions × 17 floors — procedurally generated every run
Battle, Event, Elite, Shrine, Shop — diverse room types
Different maps, enemy combos, and card drops every time

■ Features
Turn-based strategy + deckbuilding
Diverse heroes, skills, relics, and enemies
Seal System — design your own difficulty with Trials and Contracts
Procedurally generated dungeons
6 languages supported — Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese, German, French
Cloud save
Tear the dungeon apart with your own strategy.
One run is never enough.
